def transform(grid):
    # Each crossing row/column of the periodic lattice carries a compact
    # code. Take the non-background color from each horizontal band at the
    # vertical separators; empty intersections are represented by the
    # repeated lattice color.
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])

    # (relative to bar background) in left-to-right order.
    out=[]
    for r,bg in bars:
        vals=[v for v in grid[r] if v!=bg]
        if vals: out.append(vals)
    return out
